attchmntText: Usha Martin Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Usha Martin Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs. 1,000 crore, a 12.4% increase year-on-year. Operating EBITDA stood at Rs. 202 crore, with margins at 20.2%. Profit after tax was Rs. 136 crore. The company reported operating cash flow of Rs. 413 crore for the half year. Net cash position was Rs. 415 crore as of September 2026. Capital expenditure for the half year was Rs. 143 crore. India Ratings and Research upgraded the long-term issuer rating to IND AA with a stable outlook.

attchmntText: USHAMART: Usha Martin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "USHA MARTIN LTD. ANNOUNCES  Q2 FY27 RESULTS".
voiceSummary: Usha Martin Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations grew 12.4% year-on-year to Rs. 1,000 crore. Operating EBITDA improved 16.5% to Rs. 201.9 crore. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 135.7 crore. The company reported a net cash position of approximately Rs. 415 crore. Operating cash flow before tax was approximately Rs. 413 crore during the first half. Capital expenditure incurred was approximately Rs. 143 crore. The company expects a stronger second half supported by domestic demand.

attchmntText: Usha Martin Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Usha Martin Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board Meeting was held on 13th November 2026. The results were reviewed by MSKA & Associates LLP. The auditor issued an unmodified conclusion. The report notes ongoing proceedings by the Enforcement Directorate and Central Bureau of Investigation regarding land attachment in Ranchi. These proceedings relate to iron ore fines sales. The company states no adjustment to the financial results is necessary pending final outcomes. The consolidated results include the holding company, its trust, subsidiaries, and joint ventures. Specific financial figures for revenue and profit are present in the attached statement but are not detailed in the summary text. The intimation was sent to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.

attchmntText: Usha Martin Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Usha Martin Limited has intimated the schedule for its Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call. The call is scheduled for Friday, 13th November 2026 at 5:00 PM IST. The intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Details are available on the company website at www.ushamartin.com. For further information, investors may contact Mr. Abhijit Paul, Chief Financial Officer, at +033 71006 511 or 403, or via email at investor@ushamartin.co.in. Additional contacts include Anoop Poojari and Devrishi Singh from CDR India. The primary dial-in numbers are +91 22 6280 1141 and +91 22 7115 8042. Toll-free numbers are available for Singapore, Hong Kong, USA, and the UK. Participants are requested to dial in five minutes prior to the scheduled start time.
